appearances.snippet: And they already have uh I have a friend of mine who went to the uh a film festival, the Cannes Film Festival last year. ... that one year after October 7th, and they already have pledged over $200 million to produce TV shows, ... movies in order to retell October 7th from the Israeli point of view.

verification.notes: The anonymous Cannes pledge claim supplies no fund, donor, project slate, or document. Current searches found no reliable contemporaneous reporting or financial record corroborating a pledge exceeding 200 million dollars.
